I will not put chemical fertilizer on this beans plot this season. It is a small intercropped piece, and with my money I would rather use a little manure and depend on the soil and rains than buy fertilizer for beans. I will plant my usual local seed, spray something for pests and weeds because legumes can suffer badly, and we will do most of the work with family labor and only hire a few hands when work is heavy.
